interface.longDescription:
Opper is a European AI gateway: one API for 700+ models from 70+ providers, run from Stockholm, with rules for which models a project may use, where its data is processed and what it may spend.

This app lets ChatGPT set up and run your Opper account for you:

- Find the right model. Search the catalogue by name, type, provider or capability, with context windows and where each route runs. This works before you sign in.
- Get started. Create a project and an API key, check that a model is available to your project, and make a test call.
- Stay in control. Create and edit rules for allowed models, regions such as EU-only, and spend.
- Follow up. Read usage by model or project, and open traces to debug a call.

You sign in with OAuth, choose the organization and approve what the app may do. Each connection is listed at platform.opper.ai/mcp/connections, where you can disconnect it.

You need an Opper account.
capabilities: Search 700+ AI models by type, provider, capability and region
Set rules for allowed models, regions and spend
Read usage by model or project
Open traces to debug a model call
defaultPrompt: Which models can I run in the EU on Opper?
Set up an Opper project and an API key for my app
Show my Opper usage this week by model

positive.description: Pick a model: compare EU-hosted models
positive.prompt: Which OpenAI and Anthropic models can I use through Opper in the EU, and what are their context windows?
positive.expected_behavior: A short list of EU-hosted OpenAI and Anthropic models with their context windows and where they run

positive.prompt: Show my Opper account, plan and projects.
positive.expected_behavior: The connected organization, its plan and its projects

positive.description: Set up an app: project and API key
positive.prompt: Create an Opper project called chatgpt-demo and an API key for it.
positive.expected_behavior: A new project called chatgpt-demo and an API key ID; the secret is not shown by default

positive.prompt: Only allow EU-hosted models in the chatgpt-demo project.
positive.expected_behavior: An EU-only rule on chatgpt-demo, confirmed by listing the project's rules

positive.prompt: How many calls and tokens did my organization use this week, by model?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls, tokens and errors for the last 7 days, grouped by model

negative.description: Image generation is not supported: the app has no image tool and call_model is text and structured output only
negative.prompt: Generate an image of a cat in Stockholm.

negative.description: Purchases are not supported: the app has no payment tool; credits are managed only in the Opper platform
negative.prompt: Buy $50 of Opper credits for me.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the app should not be triggered
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Stockholm today?

publication.release_notes: First release: search Opper's model catalogue, set up projects and API keys, manage rules for models, regions and spend, and read usage and traces.
